name: MQL5 Wizard MA RSI
summary: This EA is an MQL5 Wizard-generated trading system that combines Moving Average trend direction with RSI momentum confirmation to generate buy and sell signals. It enters long positions when price is above the MA and RSI indicates oversold recovery, and enters short positions when price is below the MA and RSI indicates overbought reversal. The strategy uses fixed lot sizing and applies standard stop loss and take profit levels for trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA是由MQL5向导生成的交易系统，结合移动平均线趋势方向与RSI动量确认来产生买卖信号。当价格在MA上方且RSI指示超卖回升时做多，当价格在MA下方且RSI指示超买回落时做空。策略使用固定手数，并采用标准止损止盈进行交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于双重指标确认机制：移动平均线（MA）用于确定主趋势方向，RSI作为动量过滤器提供入场时机。做多条件为价格位于MA之上且RSI从超卖区域回升，做空条件为价格位于MA之下且RSI从超买区域回落。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，不根据账户余额或波动率动态调整。资金管理依赖预设的止损和止盈参数，但缺少追踪止损和仓位缩放机制。出场完全依赖止损止盈触发，没有基于指标反转的主动出场逻辑，可能导致盈利回吐或错过最佳平仓时机。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy employs a dual-indicator confirmation mechanism: Moving Average determines the primary trend direction while RSI serves as a momentum filter for entry timing. Long entries require price above MA and RSI recovering from oversold levels, while short entries require price below MA and RSI declining from overbought levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management relies on preset stop loss and take profit parameters but lacks trailing stop and position scaling mechanisms. Exits depend entirely on stop loss and take profit triggers without active indicator-based exit logic, which may lead to profit givebacks or missed optimal closing opportunities.

pros: 双指标确认减少虚假信号，趋势方向与动量结合提高入场质量
MQL5向导生成代码结构规范，易于理解和修改
固定止损止盈提供基本风险保护，适合初学者学习
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals by combining trend direction with momentum for higher-quality entries
MQL5 Wizard-generated code follows standard structure making it easy to understand and modify
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide basic risk protection suitable for beginner learning
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户规模和波动率，资金管理过于简单
缺少追踪止损机制，盈利交易可能大幅回吐
无新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓，增加过度交易风险
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing ignores account size and volatility resulting in overly simplistic money management
Lack of trailing stop mechanism means winning trades may give back significant profits
No new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same bar increasing overtrading risk
improvements: 加入动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户余额调整手数大小
增加追踪止损和基于指标反转的主动出场逻辑
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity to improve risk-adjusted returns
Implement trailing stop and indicator-based reversal exit logic for better trade management

risk_points: 固定手数在市场波动剧烈时可能导致单笔风险过大
缺少新K线检查可能在快速行情中产生重复信号导致过度持仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing may result in excessive per-trade risk during high market volatility
Lack of new bar check may produce duplicate signals during rapid market moves leading to overexposure
